title: Beyond the Chat Box
description: Understand the four shapes AI takes in real software — chat, API call, agent, embedded feature — and which one actually fits a given job, instead of reaching for whichever one you read about last.

title: Small Automations That Pay Off
description: Find a real repetitive task worth automating, wire an AI step into a chain of tools without writing code, place that step correctly, and build in what happens when it fails — so the automation still holds up unattended two weeks later.

title: What It Costs
description: Understand how token-based billing actually works, estimate a workflow's real cost before building it, choose between subscriptions and usage billing deliberately, match model cost to task difficulty, and know what actually happens when a free tier runs out.

title: Your Own AI System
description: Assemble a personal library of tested, reusable prompts and templates for the things you actually do repeatedly — including versions light enough for a low-capacity day — and keep it maintained and shareable instead of letting it rot.

title: Capstone — Solve a Real Problem
description: Choose a real problem worth solving, design an approach with success checks defined up front, build and test it against messy real cases, measure whether it actually helped, and write up an honest account someone else could learn from — bringing together everything from this phase.
